svg.title: The best published energies, by system size
svg.desc: Number of sites (x) against relative gap to the exact ground-state energy (y, log scale, lower is better) for 969 published energies and 214 exact energies on 327 exactly solved instances.
svg.text: The best published energies, by system size
Results are placed by their relative gap to the exact ground-state energy so that different Hamiltonians share one axis. A
better energy is lower. Above size 242 there are only Heisenberg and Hubbard model results, because they have an exact
ground-state energy as reference. For other Hamiltonians at larger system sizes, see below.
relative gap to the instance's exact energy (lower is better)
